get.description: Check whether the API server is ready to accept requests.
Retrieve server capabilities for the requested location.
List the configured formatters and whether each one is available.
Retrieve the merged configuration for the requested location.

patch.description: Merge V2 config keys into the user's global config file (objects merge, null removes a key). A V1-shaped file is migrated to V2 on first write and its original kept as a backup. Locations opened afterwards read the new values.

get.description: Retrieve available providers and their default models for the requested location.
Retrieve the full provider catalog and its default models for the requested location.
List the language servers configured for the location and whether each is connected.
Get the status of every configured Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.

post.description: Connect a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.
Disconnect a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.

Run the OAuth flow for a remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) server: opens a browser on the server host, waits for the authorization callback, stores the tokens, and reconnects. Responds with the resulting status.

delete.description: Forget the stored OAuth credentials of a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server and reconnect it without them.

get.description: Get all available MCP resources from connected Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.
Resolve the requested location or the server default location.
Get the home, state, config and checkout paths for the requested location.
Retrieve currently registered agents.

schema.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned as cursor.previous or cursor.next in the previous response.

get.description: Retrieve sessions in the requested order. Items keep that order across pages; use cursor.next or cursor.previous to move through the ordered list.

post.description: Create a session at the requested location.

get.description: Retrieve foreground Session drains currently owned by this OpenCode process. Sessions absent from the result are inactive.
Retrieve a session by ID.

post.description: Switch the agent used by subsequent provider turns.
Switch the model used by subsequent provider turns.
Durably admit one session input and schedule agent-loop execution unless resume is false.
Load a skill by name and inject its instructions into the session.
Run a shell command in the session directory and record it in the session.
Compact a session conversation.
Wait for a session agent loop to become idle.
Stage or move a reversible session boundary and optionally apply its file changes.

get.description: Retrieve the active context messages for a session (all messages after the last compaction).
Read the session's structured todo list.

post.description: Render a slash-command template and admit it as session input.
Create a new session by replaying this session's history with fresh ids.

get.description: Files changed by the session since its first recorded snapshot, or within the turn that answered `messageID`.
Whether the session has an active agent loop in this process.
List sessions spawned from this session.
Read one finite page of public durable Session events after an exclusive aggregate sequence. Newly committed events may appear on later pages.
Replay durable events after an aggregate sequence, then continue with new durable events.

post.description: Interrupt active execution owned by this OpenCode process. Idle interruption is a no-op.

get.description: Retrieve one projected message owned by the Session.

schema.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned as cursor.previous or cursor.next in the previous response. Do not combine with order.

get.description: Retrieve projected messages for a session. Items keep the requested order across pages; use cursor.next or cursor.previous to move through the ordered timeline.
Retrieve available models ordered by release date.
Retrieve the model a session without an explicit model runs with: the configured default when it is available, otherwise the newest available model. Null when no model is available.
Retrieve active AI providers so clients can show provider availability and configuration.
Retrieve a single AI provider so clients can inspect its availability and endpoint settings.
Retrieve available integrations and their authentication methods.
Retrieve one integration and its authentication methods.

post.description: Run a key authentication method and store the resulting credential.
Start an OAuth attempt and return the authorization details.

get.description: Poll the current status of an OAuth attempt.

delete.description: Cancel an OAuth attempt and release its resources.

post.description: Complete a code-based OAuth attempt and store the resulting credential.

get.description: Retrieve pending permission requests for a location.
Retrieve saved permissions, optionally filtered by project.

delete.description: Remove a saved permission by ID.

post.description: Evaluate and, when approval is required, create a permission request for a session.

get.description: Retrieve pending permission requests owned by a session.
Retrieve a pending permission request owned by a session.

post.description: Respond to a pending permission request owned by a session.

get.description: Read a location-relative file as UTF-8 text or base64 binary content.
Serve one file relative to the requested location.
List direct children of one directory relative to the requested location.
Find recursively ranked filesystem entries relative to the requested location.
Retrieve currently registered commands.
Retrieve currently registered skills.
Subscribe to native event payloads for the server.
List the shells installed on the server host and whether each can run a terminal session.
List PTY sessions for a location, including exited sessions retained until removal.

post.description: Create a pseudo-terminal session for a location.

get.description: Get one PTY session, including its exit code once exited.

put.description: Update the title or viewport size of one PTY session.

delete.description: Terminate and remove one PTY session.

post.description: Create a short-lived single-use ticket for opening a PTY WebSocket connection.

get.description: Establish a WebSocket connection streaming PTY output and accepting terminal input.
Retrieve pending question requests for a location.
Retrieve pending question requests owned by a session.

post.description: Answer a pending question request owned by a session.
Reject a pending question request owned by a session.

get.description: List references available in the requested location.
List every known project with its display metadata.
Resolve the project for the requested location.
List the known directories for a project.

patch.description: Update a project's name, icon, or workspace start command.

post.description: Create a git repository in the requested directory unless it is already in one, and return the project it now belongs to.

get.description: Retrieve version control info such as the current branch for the requested location.
Retrieve changed files in the working tree without patches for the requested location.
Retrieve per-file patches for uncommitted changes (`working`) or for the current branch since it diverged from the default branch (`branch`).
List the workspaces registered for the requested location's project.

post.description: Create a workspace for the requested location's project.

get.description: Report the connection status of workspaces in the requested location's project.
List the workspace adapters available to the requested location's project.

post.description: Register workspaces returned by the project's workspace adapters.
Move a session's sync history into a workspace, or detach it to the local project.

Create a git worktree of the requested location's project on a new `miao/<name>` branch. Returns at once; `worktree.ready` or `worktree.failed` follows for the new directory, then the project's start command runs there.

delete.description: Remove a git worktree of the requested location's project, its directory, and its branch.

post.description: Reset a secondary git worktree to the project's default branch, discarding every local change, then rerun the start command.
Move a session to another project directory, optionally transferring local changes.

get.description: Status of the `miao remote` daemon: connectors, accounts, push usage, and held results. Other servers answer 404.

post.description: Start logging in to an IM connector. Follow the returned flow with the event route.

get.description: Server-sent login steps (QR code, input requests, pairing code, done, error); ends with the flow.

post.description: Answer the pending code (string) or form (record) step of a login flow.

delete.description: Cancel a login flow that has not finished.
Stop an account's channel and delete its credentials.

post.description: Issue a one-time pairing code; the first person to send it to the bot becomes its owner. Only for connectors whose login cannot name an owner.
Send a short test message to the account's owner.

autoupdate.description: Automatically update to the latest version. Set to true to auto-update, false to disable, or 'notify' to show update notifications

formatter.description: Enable or configure formatters. Omit or set to false to disable, true to enable built-ins, or an object to enable built-ins with overrides.

lsp.description: Enable or configure LSP servers. Omit or set to false to disable, true to enable built-ins, or an object to enable built-ins with overrides.

status.description: Current status of the task: pending, in_progress, completed, cancelled

priority.description: Priority level of the task: high, medium, low

ServerConfig.description: Server configuration for opencode serve and web commands

color.description: Hex color code (e.g., #FF5733) or theme color (e.g., primary)

timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for full requests to this provider. Set to false to disable timeout.

headerTimeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds to wait for response headers (default: 300000). Set to false to disable timeout.

chunkTimeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds between streamed SSE chunks for this provider (default: 300000). If no chunk arrives within this window, the request is aborted. Set to false to disable timeout.

command.description: Command and arguments to run the MCP server

url.description: URL of the remote MCP server

oauth.description: OAuth authentication configuration for the MCP server. Set to false to disable OAuth auto-detection.

start.description: Startup script to run when creating a new workspace (worktree)

answers.description: User answers in order of questions (each answer is an array of selected labels)
